datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule throughout 2016 and spatially mapped to administrative units in Chad. The dataset represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity phases across different scenarios, providing geographic classifications of food security status at specific collection dates.
